notablePrerequisites:
Ghastly Mimicry attached to Timestream Navigator.
You have the city's blessing.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Ghastly Mimicry triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the Timestream Navigator copy by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
